title: 3 SPEED AUTO TRANS-NEUTRAL SAFETY SWITCH & ADJUSTMENT
summary: Neutral safety switch (also the backup-lamp switch) for the 3-speed automatic (RPO M40), mounted on the console shifter lever & bracket assembly. The switch is screwed to the shifter bracket with a lock washer and plain washer, located by pin (A) on the shifter engaging its slide block; its connector bodies are taped to the instrument panel harness connectors. Includes the installation pinning steps and a start/no-start inspection check.

parts.name: SWITCH ASM.
parts.name_expanded: Neutral safety & backing lamp switch assembly

parts.name: TAPE
parts.name_expanded: Tape – connector bodies to instrument panel harness

fastening.note: Screw [3] goes through lock washer [2] and plain washer [1] and the switch [4] tab into the shifter bracket; pin (A) on the lever & bracket asm locates the switch's slide block.
Tape [5], 8 in. long (note A), wraps the neutral safety and backing lamp switch connector bodies to the instrument panel harness connector bodies.

notes: A: 8 inches (Used to tape neutral safety & backing lamp switch connector bodies to instrument panel harness connector bodies.)
PIN (A) - PART OF LEVER & BRKT ASM

Installation: 1) line up the .093/.097 hole in the switch with the DRIVE tang and insert a pin .25 deep to hold the tang; 2) fit the switch to the lever & bracket with pin (A) in the switch slide block; 3) tighten the attaching parts to torque; 4) remove the pin.

Inspection: in NEUTRAL, take up linkage play counter-clockwise (do not leave the transmission detent), turn key to START: engine starts, car must not move; repeat moving the lever clockwise. In REVERSE (play taken up clockwise) and in DRIVE (play taken up counter-clockwise), START must not crank the engine. Never move out of the transmission detent while checking.
